name: Ternary Bonsai 2 (27B, 9B, 2B) GGUF

lineage.base_model: Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B (27B); 9B and 2B derived from the corresponding Qwen3.8 sizes (not checked)
lineage.how_derived: end-to-end ternary weights {-1,0,+1} with FP16 group scale (g128) incl. embeddings, attention, MLP and LM head, blockwise Hadamard rotation (block 1024) folded into the weights, vision tower kept in a separate Q8_0 mmproj (card)

purpose: Full 27B-class reasoning in about 6 GB so it runs on a laptop or a single consumer GPU; keeps thinking, reasoning and agentic behaviour where conventional low-bit quants collapse (card).

license.name: Apache-2.0
license.notes: LICENSE file in the 27B GGUF repo is the Apache License 2.0 (header opened); card says Apache 2.0. Base Qwen3.8-27B's own licence not checked here.

architecture.kind: hybrid attention (about 75% linear, 25% full), SwiGLU MLP, 64 blocks + 2.54B embedding/LM head + 0.46B vision tower (27 blocks), Qwen3.8-27B backbone, ternary g128 weights
architecture.gguf_arch: Qwen3.8 hybrid (llama.cpp mainline from b11556 loads the Q2_0 pack)

variants.notes: needs the fork; faster on H100/A100/Blackwell and prompt processing
runs in mainline llama.cpp from b11556; older builds load it silently and output garbage (card)
2.0 / 2.42 / 2.56 GB; also MTP and DFlash2 drafter files

pc-12gb.notes: plus KV cache; hybrid attention keeps it small

pc-24gb.notes: vendor llama-bench on RTX 4090 24 GB: PTQ1_0 91.1 tok/s decode (tg128), 1645 prefill (pp512)

pc-32gb.notes: vendor: RTX 5090 32 GB PQ2_0 129.9 tok/s decode, 3893 prefill

mac-32gb.notes: vendor: M5 Pro laptop PQ2_0 28.1 tok/s decode, 387 prefill

mac-64gb+.notes: vendor: Apple M5 Max about 47 tok/s decode per the card highlights

engine_support.notes: PTQ1_0 and PQ2_0 need the fork's ternary hybrid-attention kernels; stock llama.cpp b11556 or newer runs only the Q2_0 pack.

benchmarks.name: average over 14 thinking-mode benchmarks
benchmarks.variant: ternary g128 (98.2% of FP16 per card)
benchmarks.harness: vendor whitepaper; conventional IQ2_XXS build 72.59, UD-Q4_K_XL within 0.4 points at 3x the footprint

benchmarks.name: math average / coding average / agentic tool calling
benchmarks.harness: card: math within half a point of FP16, coding level with the baseline

benchmarks.name: decode tg128 / prefill pp512, RTX 4090 24 GB
decode tg128 / prefill pp512, RTX 5090 32 GB

strengths: 27B-class reasoning at 6-7 GB, hybrid attention keeps long-context KV small
1.37M downloads, 3,072 likes of the 27B GGUF within 9 weeks
9B and 2B siblings with MTP / DFlash2 drafter files
weaknesses: fastest packs need a forked llama.cpp; stock only gets Q2_0
older stock llama.cpp silently produces garbage on Q2_0
reasoning defaults to xhigh effort and needs a large -n budget
best_for: laptop or small-GPU local agents wanting a 27B-class thinking model
soft.maturity: Prism ML, earlier Bonsai releases since 2026-03; the whitepaper and a demo repo are the tested-setup reference.

tona_fit.reason: A 27B-class thinking and agentic model in 6-7 GB is exactly the lever for 12 and 16 GB cards and 16-24 GB Macs; vendor numbers (98.2% of FP16, coding level with the baseline) need our own coding check with the eval checklist. Open: the ternary hybrid-attention kernel is a custom type, so a Tona backend needs its own implementation; the Q2_0 pack is the portable one.
